weapons.name: Zenith
weapons.source: Crafted from the full Zenith sword chain
weapons.why: This is the unquestioned melee endgame centerpiece because nothing else matches its screen-wide damage and reach.

weapons.name: Meowmere
weapons.why: Even before you finish Zenith, this is a top-tier Moon Lord drop and an important ingredient in the final craft.

weapons.name: Star Wrath
weapons.why: It remains a premier sword on its own and also matters as one of the last Zenith ingredients.

weapons.name: Terrarian
weapons.why: If you want the strongest yoyo route instead of the sword route, this is the one that defines it.

armor.name: Solar Flare Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Solar Fragments and Luminite Bars
armor.why: This remains the best melee armor in the game because its survivability and shield charges are still unmatched.

armor.name: Beetle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Beetle Husks and Turtle Armor
armor.why: It is outclassed now, but still worth listing as the immediate pre-Lunar carry-over many players will still recognize.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: It remains the most obvious melee-specific accessory because the offensive package never really stops being efficient.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: The huge all-around stat package makes it one of the best universal endgame accessories regardless of class.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: If you want the strongest wings in the game, this is the mobility end point for late builds.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: The dodge and dash are still excellent even in the very last content the game offers.

buffs.name: Golden Delight
buffs.why: This is the best endgame food buff and the cleanest default top pick once pure optimization is the goal.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense reduction still adds meaningful value even when your raw damage is already enormous.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: More health is still one of the cleanest universal upgrades for challenge runs and optional bosses.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase stays valuable once the goal shifts from progression to optimization.

weapons.name: S.D.M.G.
weapons.why: The research resolves the endgame ranger debate in favor of S.D.M.G. as the default top pick.

weapons.name: Phantasm
weapons.source: Crafted from Vortex Fragments and Luminite Bars
weapons.why: It remains a co-best weapon in practice and still defines the endgame bow route.

weapons.name: Vortex Beater
weapons.source: Crafted from Vortex Fragments and Luminite Bars
weapons.why: This remains a premier gun option if you prefer its burst-fire pattern over the Moon Lord drop route.

weapons.name: Celebration MK2
weapons.why: It is a spectacular late launcher pick and one of ranger's most fun optional endgame weapons.

armor.name: Vortex Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Vortex Fragments and Luminite Bars
armor.why: This is the final ranger armor because the stealth and Lunar-tier stats outclass everything before it.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: It is still worth showing as the direct carry-over point for players transitioning into Moon Lord gear.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: It remains the obvious ranger-specific accessory because crit and precision still matter at the top end.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: The universal stat package makes it one of the strongest non-class-specific endgame accessory slots.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: It is the final mobility goal if you want the best wing option available.

accessories.name: Terraspark Boots
accessories.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
accessories.why: Even when wings are online, the best boots still improve the feel and consistency of a finished build.

buffs.name: Golden Delight
buffs.why: This is the cleanest universal endgame top pick because optimization is now the goal.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: Endgame ranger still wants free ammo efficiency before every serious fight.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: Extra health remains a straightforward upgrade for difficult challenge content.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: The flat damage increase is still one of the cleanest late-game consumables to justify.

weapons.name: Last Prism
weapons.why: This is the consensus top endgame mage weapon because its sustained beam damage still sits above everything else.

weapons.name: Lunar Flare
weapons.why: It remains a powerful alternative when you want a more positional, targeted mage tool instead of a pure beam.

weapons.name: Nebula Blaze
weapons.source: Crafted from Nebula Fragments and Luminite Bars
weapons.why: It is still a great carry-over even after Moon Lord drops open the final tier.

weapons.name: Razorblade Typhoon
weapons.why: Its homing pressure remains useful enough that it still deserves a place in the final pool.

armor.name: Nebula Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Nebula Fragments and Luminite Bars
armor.why: This is the final mage armor because the Nebula boosters make it the most complete endgame package.

armor.name: Spectre Armor
armor.why: It remains a recognizable carry-over for players who still swap sets situationally.

accessories.name: Celestial Emblem
accessories.why: It stays the best mage accessory because the damage and mana support still scale into the final tier.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: The universal stat package is strong enough to remain relevant even for the most specialized mage builds.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: It is the final mobility prize if you want the best possible aerial control.

accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.why: Auto-potion support remains useful even when your mana tools are otherwise maximized.

buffs.name: Golden Delight
buffs.why: This is the obvious universal top pick once the focus shifts fully to best-in-slot play.

buffs.name: Crystal Ball
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Wizard
buffs.why: Free Clairvoyance remains a baseline endgame mage habit before any serious fight.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: Extra health continues to matter during challenge runs and optional endgame bosses.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: A direct damage increase still translates well even at the very end of progression.

weapons.name: Stardust Dragon Staff
weapons.source: Crafted from Stardust Fragments and Luminite Bars
weapons.why: The research still marks this as the best practical endgame summoner weapon because the scaling is absurd and the route is accessible.

weapons.name: Terraprisma
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light during the day
weapons.why: If you can earn it, it sits in the very top tier of summon damage and remains a true prestige pickup.

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light during the day
weapons.why: This is the best whip in the game and the natural pairing for a fully optimized endgame summoner.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Earned from Old One's Army Tier 3 progression
weapons.why: It remains a very strong carry-over whip if you are not routing the hardest optional Empress drops.

armor.name: Stardust Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Stardust Fragments and Luminite Bars
armor.why: This is the final summoner armor because the extra slot and Guardian utility keep it ahead of earlier sets.

armor.name: Tiki Armor
armor.why: It remains a recognizable carry-over option for players still finalizing their Stardust setup.

accessories.name: Papyrus Scarab
accessories.why: This remains the best summon-focused accessory because more minion value is still the best possible stat.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: The universal stat package is strong enough to justify a slot even in a highly optimized summoner build.

accessories.name: Celestial Starboard
accessories.why: It is the final mobility capstone if you want the best endgame wings available.

accessories.name: Pygmy Necklace
accessories.why: An extra minion remains valuable enough that it still deserves a place in the final pool.

buffs.name: Golden Delight
buffs.why: It is the final universal food buff and the easiest top pick once pure optimization is the goal.

buffs.name: Bewitching Table
buffs.source: Placed station buff from the Dungeon
buffs.why: A free extra minion remains part of every serious endgame summoner setup.

buffs.name: Lifeforce Potion
buffs.why: More health still matters once you are using this build for optional challenge clears.

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.why: The damage increase remains straightforward value even after full gear progression is complete.
